theme: A wide-open day with two booking windows closing.
greeting: Morning, Dan. The calendar is nearly empty today, which is lucky — the December trip and the Maine Christmas rental both want a decision this week, and this is the day with room to make them.

needsAttention.title: December break — decide and book
needsAttention.detail: The Dec 13–Jan 2 trip for all four girls needs a destination locked and booked by Oct 15, two days out. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year; the default is domestic, since passports won't be in hand at booking.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Book a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week now — it's the hardest rental in that market and it sells out. Dates can be adjusted later, and holding one early costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week gap is the window to drive the Pathfinder from Portland to St Pete. Book the single hotel night once the dates are set.

flagged.title: Outreach still awaiting replies
flagged.detail: Your follow-ups to John Roe at BlackRock and Jonathan Dunne at Deloitte are both out from last week and unanswered — nothing owed on your side yet.

inbox.noise: The rest of the inbox is promotions — Crate & Barrel, Kayak, sailing trips, F1 hotels.
